faults.blocked_prerequisites: Bounded synthetic worker; watchdog and process cleanup available
faults.expected_fail_closed_result: No acceptance from incomplete work; bounded termination, explicit timeout and retry only under a new attempt identity.
faults.injection: Synthetic worker held past a bounded monotonic deadline
faults.name: worker_timeout
faults.observed_injection_requirement: Supervisor deadline/termination event with worker identity and no successful receipt
required_evidence: Supervisor deadline/termination event with worker identity and no successful receipt

faults.blocked_prerequisites: Disposable worker process and retained supervisor events
faults.boundary: worker process exit before receipt admission

faults.injection: Synthetic worker exits nonzero before committing an output receipt
faults.name: worker_crash
faults.observed_injection_requirement: Exit/signal event and receipt-store scan proving no complete receipt
required_evidence: Exit/signal event and receipt-store scan proving no complete receipt

faults.blocked_prerequisites: Injectable fake provider and strict parser boundary

required_evidence: Exact fake-provider response bytes/hash and parser rejection event

rule: Configured or requested injection is not observed injection. Unobserved injections are INVALID trials, never PASS. Execute only in disposable environments with an external deadline.
